verdict.rationale: FFmpeg's documentation could plausibly ship an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. Probes show https://ffmpeg.org/llms.txt and the markdown docs variant both return HTTP 404, and nothing in the pack describes agent-oriented documentation. Community reports of users asking LLMs to generate commands are a user-side workaround, not a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
